name: StablR Euro
who_can_redeem: StablR documentation describes fiat conversion for eligible business customers through StablR accounts, registered bank accounts, and whitelisted institutional wallets; official incident updates state minting and redemption remain suspended during recovery.
redemption_region_notes: Business onboarding, account verification, bank-account registration, wallet whitelisting, jurisdictional eligibility, and current incident-response restrictions apply.
redemption_notes: StablR documentation describes 1:1 fiat conversion infrastructure, but official incident updates take precedence for current state: minting and redemption remain suspended while recovery work continues.
summary: EUR-referenced StablR electronic money token. Following the May 2026 security incident and unauthorized issuance, the incident was contained and no further unauthorized issuance was reported, but minting and redemption remained suspended in the latest reviewed official recovery update.
notes: Growth Batch V. Restricted lifecycle reflects explicit current incident-response controls; generic service-status availability is not treated as proof that minting or redemption resumed.
